Sub: Disclosure pursuant to Regulation 29 (2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and 
Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 in relation to equity shares of PATEL ENGINEERING LIMITED 
 
Pursuant to the disclosure required to be made under Regulation 29 ( 2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of 
Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, please find attached the disclosure in respect of the release of pledged 
equity shares  and acquisition of NDU  of “ PATEL ENGINEERING LIMITED ” by “Catalyst Trusteeship 
Limited” in the capacity of Debenture Trustee for the benefit of Debenture Holders.
